name: 工程蓝图
description: 工程图纸质感：深钴蓝底 #0B3D66 + 白细线 #E5F0FA + 浅蓝 #64B5F6 + 网格感。H1 uppercase 大号白字 + 下方双细线（刻度感），H2 浅蓝 + 左侧细竖线，p 浅白色等宽字体，代码块带尺寸刻度线感。独一份工程图纸感（工业制图/CAD 图风）。适合硬核技术架构/系统设计/工程决策。

styles.h1: font-size: 24px; font-weight: 700; color: #E5F0FA; text-align: center; line-height: 1.3; margin-top: 38px; margin-bottom: 26px; padding-bottom: 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid #64B5F6; letter-spacing: 4px; text-transform: uppercase;
styles.h2: font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; color: #64B5F6; line-height: 1.4; margin-top: 32px; margin-bottom: 16px; padding-left: 14px; border-left: 1px solid #64B5F6; letter-spacing: 2px; text-transform: uppercase;
styles.h3: font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; color: #E5F0FA; line-height: 1.5; margin-top: 26px; margin-bottom: 12px; letter-spacing: 1.5px; text-transform: uppercase;
styles.h4: font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; color: #64B5F6; line-height: 1.55; margin-top: 22px; margin-bottom: 10px; letter-spacing: 2px; text-transform: uppercase;
styles.h5: font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: #B8D4EE; margin-top: 18px; margin-bottom: 8px; line-height: 1.55;
styles.h6: font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; color: #7FA8CE; margin-top: 16px; margin-bottom: 6px; line-height: 1.55; letter-spacing: 1.5px; text-transform: uppercase;
styles.p: font-size: 15px; color: #E5F0FA; line-height: 1.8; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 16px; letter-spacing: 0.3px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono','SF Mono','PingFang SC',monospace;
styles.blockquote: background: rgba(100,181,246,0.10); border-left: 1px dashed #64B5F6; border-radius: 0; margin-top: 22px; margin-bottom: 22px; font-size: 13px; color: #B8D4EE; line-height: 1.75; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono','SF Mono',monospace;
styles.blockquote p: font-size: 13px; color: #B8D4EE; line-height: 1.75; margin-bottom: 0; background: transparent;
styles.a: color: #64B5F6; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-style: dashed; text-underline-offset: 3px;
styles.img: max-width: 100%; display: block; margin-top: 18px; margin-bottom: 18px; border: 1px solid #64B5F6; background: transparent;
styles.hr: margin-top: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px; height: 0; border: none; border-top: 1px dashed #64B5F6;
styles.code: background: rgba(100,181,246,0.15); border-radius: 0; font-size: 90%; color: #E5F0FA; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono','SF Mono',Menlo,monospace; border: 1px solid #64B5F6;
styles.pre: background: #062540; border: 1px solid #64B5F6; border-radius: 0; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; overflow: hidden; color: #E5F0FA; overflow-x: auto; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.7; white-space: pre-wrap;
styles.pre::before: display: flex; align-items: center; height: 28px; background: #64B5F6; color: #0B3D66; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 2px; text-transform: uppercase;
styles.pre code: background: none; color: #E5F0FA; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono','SF Mono',Menlo,monospace;
styles.table: width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin-top: 20px; margin-bottom: 20px; font-size: 13px; border: 1px solid #64B5F6; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono',monospace;
styles.th: text-align: left; font-weight: 700; color: #0B3D66; background: #64B5F6; letter-spacing: 1.5px; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 11px; border: 1px solid #64B5F6;
styles.li: font-size: 14px; color: #E5F0FA; line-height: 1.8; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono','SF Mono',monospace; display: flex; margin-bottom: 6px; align-items: flex-start;
